name: caraml
description: Language support for CaraML backed by the language server.

caraml.server.path.markdownDescription: Path to the caraml executable (empty: `$CARAML_SERVER`, else `caraml` on PATH, else in `$XDG_BIN_HOME` or `~/.local/bin`). When none is found, `CaraML: Set Up Language Server` offers to download or build one into `~/.local/bin`, or to locate one, which sets this.

caraml.server.args.markdownDescription: Global options passed before the `lsp` command, e.g. `["-vv"]` for debug logs (shown in the CaraML LSP output channel).

caraml.abbreviations.enabled.markdownDescription: Replace backslash abbreviations as you type: `\alpha` becomes `α`, `\to` becomes `→` (the canonical arrow), `\le` becomes `≤`.

caraml.displaySymbols.enabled.markdownDescription: Display ASCII symbols as Unicode without changing the file: `->` is drawn as `→` but stays `->` on disk. The symbol under the cursor is shown as typed. Toggle with `CaraML: Toggle Unicode Display` (`Ctrl+Alt+\`) or the `ascii`/`utf8` status bar item.

caraml.displaySymbols.symbols.markdownDescription: Symbols displayed by `#caraml.displaySymbols.enabled#`, from a whole symbol run to its display. A run is replaced only as a whole: `-->` is not drawn as `-→`.

caraml.inlayHints.enabled.description: Show inferred type hints inline after value bindings.

caraml.inlayHints.literals.markdownDescription: Also annotate bindings whose value is an obvious literal (e.g. `= 42`, `= "…"`). Off by default, since the type merely restates the syntax.

caraml.inlayHints.hideTypeVariables.markdownDescription: Suppress hints whose inferred type is an unsolved type variable (e.g. `t0`). These usually indicate types the compiler could not resolve rather than genuine polymorphism.
